blocks.html: Anyone who is addicted to opioids needs to know how to safely detox from opioids so that they have the best chance of recovery and the most comfortable recovery experience. So what are opioids?
blocks.text: Anyone who is addicted to opioids needs to know how to safely detox from opioids so that they have the best chance of recovery and the most comfortable recovery experience. So what are opioids?

blocks.html: Opioids are a specific group of drugs that are all derived from the poppy plant. Opioids are used to block the pain signals that are sent from your brain to the rest of your body, so they are commonly used as prescription painkillers.
blocks.text: Opioids are a specific group of drugs that are all derived from the poppy plant. Opioids are used to block the pain signals that are sent from your brain to the rest of your body, so they are commonly used as prescription painkillers.

blocks.html: There are many types of opioids, such as prescription Oxycontin or Vicodin. Other drugs that are opioids include fentanyl which is a synthetic opioid 100 times more potent than Morphine. Morphine is another example. Outside of prescription drugs, the illegal version of opioids is heroin.

blocks.html: Using opioids brings with it a high level of risk, even if they are prescription-based. Regular use of any opioid increases your tolerance to that drug. An increased physical tolerance means an increased dependence. The more you use a given opioid, the more you will need it. And each time you use it, you will need more of it to get the same response.
blocks.text: Using opioids brings with it a high level of risk, even if they are prescription-based. Regular use of any opioid increases your tolerance to that drug. An increased physical tolerance means an increased dependence. The more you use a given opioid, the more you will need it. And each time you use it, you will need more of it to get the same response.

blocks.html: This can be particularly dangerous in situations where you are given a prescription for pain management after surgery or after a car accident. Each time you take your prescription opioid to help with your pain, your body becomes more dependent on it, and you require more of it. So instead of taking just one pill each day as your doctor advised, you start taking two pills, and then the next week, you start taking three pills. Before long, you have used all of the pills in your prescription, but you still have a few weeks left before you can get a refill.

blocks.html: If you are addicted to opioids, you need to know how to safely detox from opioids. Opioids are a class of drugs that require medically-assisted detox in order to safely withdraw from drug use.
blocks.text: If you are addicted to opioids, you need to know how to safely detox from opioids. Opioids are a class of drugs that require medically-assisted detox in order to safely withdraw from drug use.

blocks.html: Early symptoms will typically include things like insomnia, runny nose, anxiety, agitation, muscle pain, severe sweating, and yawning. But after a few days, the later symptoms can include nausea and vomiting, diarrhea, cramps, dilated pupils, and goosebumps.

blocks.html: Depending on your situation, your current level of health, and any other addictions or mental health problems, proper opioid detox programs can help you overcome the safety risks associated with a detox. Medically supervised programs will help wean you from your opioids by giving you other FDA-approved medications as you overcome the symptoms, and help ease your comfort while also being on call for any medical complications that arise.
